card.title: How to Repair iPhone Air Error 4010

source.title: How to Repair iPhone Air Error 4010

claims.statement: On iPhone Air, restore error 4010 midway (progress bar visible) means the small upper interposer board is missing, misaligned or badly soldered, usually after previous board work.
Fix: clean pads, reball the lower layer with 148/158 paste and reflow the small board aligned under a microscope, without pressing it.

procedure: Inspect for the upper small board and its joints.
Align and reflow the small board.
Restore and verify IMEI, Wi-Fi, serial.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Pressing on the board during reflow can sink pads.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
